description: Manual research leads and source-policy register. This file is deliberately not loaded by the automated discovery runtime; entries here are not approved scraping targets, candidate feeds or evidence that a listed organisation accepts speculative applications.
global_rules: Use these indexes to discover candidate organisation names only. Qualify each organisation and verify its own current official website and explicit speculative/open application route before publication.
Do not bulk scrape, mirror, or republish directory records unless an API, licence or written permission expressly supports the intended use.
Store only minimum company/provenance facts needed by the tracker; preserve source attribution and per-entity review trails.
An association membership, company directory entry, game credit, storefront developer page or job-board profile is not by itself proof of current game development or an unsolicited application route.

sources.name: Ukie Membership Directory
sources.signal: Member organisations are tagged with Developer, Co-Development, Publisher, Business Service and Education categories.
sources.accessPolicy: Manual lead review only; no bulk-reuse/API permission has been established.
sources.reviewNotes: The directory states 764 members including 420 games-company members, 38 academic members and 296 partner members. Filter by developer/co-development categories and verify each organisation.

sources.name: Ukie UK Games Map
sources.signal: Searches game businesses and institutions by region, company type or keyword.
sources.accessPolicy: Do not automate or republish map data without permission.
sources.reviewNotes: Powered by Companies House data and includes developers, publishers, service providers and institutions.

sources.name: Swedish Games Industry / Dataspelsbranschen Members
sources.signal: Separate filters for Game Studios, Distributors & Publishers, Educational members and Supporting members.
sources.accessPolicy: Manual page inspection only; no bulk-reuse permission established.
sources.reviewNotes: Use the Game Studios category first; other categories are ecosystem leads, not direct developers.

sources.name: Computer Entertainment Supplier's Association Members List
sources.signal: Regular and supporting member rosters include Japanese and overseas game-industry companies.
sources.accessPolicy: Manual lead research only; no automated harvesting or redistribution approved.
sources.reviewNotes: Members include developers, publishers, services, platform companies, schools and vendors. Verify company role.

sources.name: Korea Game Industry Association Partner List
sources.signal: Member/partner company names provide Korean ecosystem leads.
sources.accessPolicy: Manual lead research only; no bulk-reuse licence or API permission established.
sources.reviewNotes: The official member/partner roster can surface Korean game companies, but members are not all developers. Verify each company and its current activity. A previous HTTP 502 should not be treated as a permanent source closure.

sources.name: ABRAGAMES Members and Affiliates
sources.signal: Associated and affiliated companies are linked to their own websites.
sources.accessPolicy: Manual lead research only; no bulk-reuse licence established.
sources.reviewNotes: Roster includes studios, sound firms, services, educators and other organisations.

sources.name: FrenchGamesMap / SNJV
sources.signal: Member types include Studio, Publisher, Associations and technology/service providers; the 2024 survey reports 575 development studios.
sources.accessPolicy: Manual inspection only; no bulk extraction or redistribution without permission.
sources.reviewNotes: 575 is a 2024 reference figure, not a current 2026 count.

sources.name: Australian Game Developers Directory
sources.signal: Directory reports 418 studios and provides state/location filters.
sources.accessPolicy: Manual research only until site terms and permissible reuse are confirmed.
sources.reviewNotes: Verify that each entry remains active and develops digital games.

sources.name: PlayFinland Studio Profiles
sources.signal: Lists member studios of the Finnish Game Developers Association.
sources.accessPolicy: Manual lead use; no bulk-copy permission established.
sources.reviewNotes: Use official company pages to confirm activity and application routes.

sources.name: Neogames / PlayFinland Game Developer Studios on the Map
sources.signal: Finnish industry overview estimates 270 actively developing studios at end-2024.
sources.accessPolicy: Manual lead use only; dataset reuse rights not established.
sources.reviewNotes: Coverage may be inaccurate, especially for new startups; 270 refers to end-2024.

sources.name: Africa Games Week Studio Catalogue
sources.signal: Curated list of studios, creative teams and commercially released titles, stated current as of Q2 2026.
sources.accessPolicy: Manual research only; no permission for bulk reproduction established.
sources.reviewNotes: Catalogue coverage is not proof of a current open application route.

sources.name: IGDB API / Twitch Developer Services
sources.signal: Company records expose game and developer/publisher relationships, status, websites and related data.
sources.accessPolicy: The repository uses the documented IGDB Companies API through a Twitch developer application with IGDB_CLIENT_ID and IGDB_CLIENT_SECRET stored only as GitHub Actions secrets. Keep it non-commercial, server-side, minimally scoped and attributed; do not expose credentials/tokens or publish raw descriptions/credit arrays. Re-check current Twitch terms before any change in use.
sources.reviewNotes: Integrated as a recurring candidate-only feed. Developed-game credits and officially typed company website identify leads; current direct game-development activity and speculative application route must still be proven on the employer site. Existing credentials are already configured; no new user action is required.

sources.name: Steam Developer & Publisher Homepages
sources.signal: Large directory of developer and publisher storefront pages.
sources.accessPolicy: No scripted/bot collection or automated interaction. Manual leads only unless Valve provides explicit permission or approved data interface.
sources.reviewNotes: Mixes studios, publishers, parent companies and other organisations; not a unique studio count.

sources.name: GameCompanies.com
sources.signal: Global index of studios, publishers, hubs and game-service companies.
sources.accessPolicy: Do not scrape or automate without permission under current site restrictions.
sources.reviewNotes: Use only as a manual lead where permitted; verify company-owned sources.

sources.name: Games Jobs Index Studio Directory
sources.signal: Includes a speculative-application-oriented filter and studio listings.
sources.accessPolicy: Do not automate until terms/API permission have been checked and approved.
sources.reviewNotes: Displayed total and regional roll-up differed on 2026-10-31; do not use aggregate counts. Directory labels are not employer evidence.

sources.name: MobyGames API
sources.signal: Potential developer/publisher credit discovery.
sources.accessPolicy: Use only authorized API access within current key, quota, attribution and redistribution terms; no page scraping.
sources.reviewNotes: Credits may be historic, partial, publisher-only or outsourced; they are candidate signals only.

sources.name: Community Game Studios & Publishers Database
sources.signal: Secondary names and website cross-check.
sources.accessPolicy: Do not ingest or republish until the repository's current licence and provenance permit intended use.
sources.reviewNotes: Freshness and coverage are uncertain; confirm every lead on official company pages.

sources.name: BAZA POLSKI GAMEDEV — Lista A–Z
sources.signal: Alphabetical list of Polish game-development organisations with city/region labels; page stated 609 entries and last updated 2026-10-02.
sources.accessPolicy: Manual lead research only; no permission to scrape, bulk-copy or republish the list has been established.
sources.reviewNotes: The list identifies publishers and marks uncertain entries as well as developers. Use as a seed list; verify live status, actual game-development activity and each employer-owned application route independently.

sources.name: game — German Games Industry Association Members
sources.signal: Large member listing with company descriptions, locations and an industry selector; includes direct game studios, publishers, development-service firms and broader games ecosystem companies.
sources.accessPolicy: Manual lead review only; no bulk extraction or redistribution permission has been established.
sources.reviewNotes: Not a studio-only roster. Filter and read each company's self-description; include only organisations that pass direct game-development and current application-route gates.

sources.name: Game Developer Association of India — Teams and Membership Network
sources.signal: GDAI states it has 200+ member studios and publishes board, governing-council and industry-contributor affiliations including game studios, publishers and developers.
sources.accessPolicy: Manual network research only; do not scrape names or infer formal membership from leadership affiliations.
sources.reviewNotes: This is a leadership/community network rather than a complete public member directory. Use affiliations as leads, not proof that an organisation is currently a member or actively hiring.

sources.name: IGDA India National Chapter
sources.signal: National chapter supporting game developers through local communities, events, industry knowledge-sharing and global connections.
sources.accessPolicy: Community and networking source only; no member-company roster or bulk reuse permission established.
sources.reviewNotes: Not a company directory. Useful for discovering regional developer communities and events, then follow official studio channels.

sources.name: USK Member Companies
sources.signal: List of companies participating in the German Entertainment Software Self-Regulation Body, including developers, publishers and platform companies.
sources.accessPolicy: Manual lead review only; no bulk collection or redistribution permission established.
sources.reviewNotes: Membership is not a developer-only classification and includes publishers, distributors, platforms and other organisations. Verify the operating company and current development activity.

sources.name: DEV — Spanish Videogame and Entertainment Software Development Association
sources.signal: Public member roster reported 83 organisations with member names, locations and company websites.
sources.accessPolicy: Public webpage; automated harvesting and republication rights were not established. Manual lead research only pending terms/licence review.
sources.reviewNotes: Roster includes developers alongside universities, services and ecosystem organisations. Confirm direct game development on the employer's own website.

sources.name: Game Developers Association of the Philippines — Members
sources.signal: Public roster includes game-development and co-development members, with other core/supporting/education organisations also present.
sources.accessPolicy: Public page; no bulk-harvesting or redistribution permission established. Do not join or pay for access solely to collect data.
sources.reviewNotes: Prefer core game-development and co-development organisations; other member types are discovery leads only.

sources.name: African Games Report — African Game Studios
sources.signal: Curated directory lists 64 studios across 15 African countries with official website links.
sources.accessPolicy: Public article/directory; automated collection and republication rights not confirmed.
sources.reviewNotes: Valuable regional coverage gap-filler. Verify activity, direct development and current employer application route on official company pages.

sources.name: DeVuego — Latin American Video Game Studios
sources.signal: Studio directory provides activity and company/non-company distinctions that can improve manual candidate selection.
sources.accessPolicy: Do not bulk ingest or republish until a dataset licence or written permission is confirmed.
sources.reviewNotes: Promising regional reference, but check whether its entries are current, how records are sourced and whether reuse is permitted.

sources.name: COVA — Colombian Video Game Developers Association
sources.signal: Association reports representing more than 30 Colombian game studios.
sources.accessPolicy: No complete public member export identified; use public association information or direct contact only.
sources.reviewNotes: Useful network and research contact, not a harvestable company directory based on the pages reviewed.

sources.name: Africa CII — African Games Studio Directory
sources.signal: 229 organisations across 23 countries, with separate verified and community-submitted record counts.
sources.accessPolicy: Manual cross-check only; no permission for bulk reproduction was established.
sources.reviewNotes: Directory states only 20 organisations are independently verified and 209 are community records; much of the community list is derived from GameDevMap. Do not count it as an independent 229-studio discovery feed or re-import duplicate rows.

sources.name: ACRA Information on Corporate Entities — Singapore Open Data
sources.signal: 27 monthly CSV datasets of ACRA-registered entities, searchable by company name, UEN, registration status and primary/secondary SSIC. SSIC 62012 identifies Development of computer games; 58201 identifies Publishing of games software/applications. The API sample query works without an API key; a key raises rate limits and priority.
sources.accessPolicy: Official data.gov.sg Open Data Licence permits free personal and commercial reuse. Use the public datastore API or monthly CSV exports; no authentication required for basic low-rate requests. API key is optional for higher rate limits. Preserve agency attribution and refresh monthly.
sources.reviewNotes: High-value Singapore source. The public dataset contains 53 columns including entity name, active status, UEN, address and declared business activities, but no company website. Do not auto-publish or pass to speculative-route verification until an official-site resolution step or a safe match to an existing verified domain is available. Use status and primary/secondary activity; distinguish developers (62012) from publisher-only (58201).

sources.name: Croatian Games Development Alliance — Members
sources.signal: Public directory shows 50 of 50 member records and includes explicit Studio, Publisher, Education, Partner and Institution categories.
sources.accessPolicy: Public directory; no bulk-reuse/API permission was established during review. Manual lead research only until terms/licence are confirmed.
sources.reviewNotes: Useful Croatian/Balkan long-tail source. Start with Studio labels, but the category itself does not prove current activity or speculative-route acceptance. Verify on the employer's site.

sources.name: Interactive Games & Entertainment Association — Our Members
sources.signal: Public company-profile and member links for game companies; separate associate-member section includes service providers, schools and professional services.
sources.accessPolicy: Public member listing; no explicit bulk data reuse permission confirmed. Manual research only pending permission/terms review.
sources.reviewNotes: Potential additional Oceania coverage beyond the Australian Game Developers Directory. Do not treat the association's corporate roster or associate members as developer-only; read each company profile.

sources.name: Canada at gamescom 2026 — Canadian Game Companies
sources.signal: Event directory displays 100 Canadian game companies, with company descriptions, locations and partnership/co-development/publishing interests.
sources.accessPolicy: Public event directory; automated collection/republication terms were not established. Manual research only; preserve page attribution.
sources.reviewNotes: Good discovery snapshot across Canadian provinces, including smaller studios. Mixes developers, service providers, associations and publishers; inspect each description and verify active game development on the employer's own site.

sources.name: Malta Game Developers Association
sources.signal: Association constituted in May 2026; membership is open and free during its founding year and covers non-gambling video game development across PC, console, mobile and web.
sources.accessPolicy: No public member-company roster or open-data export identified. Do not pay or collect member identity data; use public association announcements and voluntary contacts only.
sources.reviewNotes: Potentially useful for finding Malta-based micro-studios and solo developers, but not an automated company directory at present.
